# Flashlight

> FOCUS-based, multi-cloud spend visualization. Finds what's burning money in the dark.

FOCUS-based, multi-cloud spend visualization. Ingests cloud billing in the FinOps FOCUS format, standardizes it into a BRONZE/SILVER/GOLD Parquet lake, and serves a bundled dashboard plus an MCP server for agents. Installs with `pip install getflashlight` — no Docker, no database server.


## Docs

- [Home](https://getflashlight.app/index.md): Overview — what Flashlight is and why the numbers are trustworthy
- [Quickstart](https://getflashlight.app/quickstart/index.md): Sample data to a running dashboard in two commands
- [Data architecture](https://getflashlight.app/architecture/index.md): The BRONZE → SILVER → GOLD lake and its invariants
- [Mapping details](https://getflashlight.app/connectors/index.md): AWS, Databricks, Redshift, and the mapping SQL
- [CLI](https://getflashlight.app/reference/cli/index.md): Every `flashlight` command

## Design

- [Efficiency and recoverable spend](https://getflashlight.app/design/efficiency-waste/index.md): The efficiency/waste GOLD group and its rules
- [AI costs and usage](https://getflashlight.app/design/ai-costs/index.md): AI/LLM spend, token attribution per project and user, and why a $/token figure is only honest for pay-per-token serving
